TEXT: [FI] S-Say, Saori... Right now, Kirino...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Saori.

TEXT: [FI] And this person is...

TEXT: [FI] Hmph... At least her mouth is still the same.

TEXT: [FI] Kiririn-shi...

TEXT: [FI] S-Say, Saori. Kirino is currently...

TEXT: [FI] ...I understand, Kyousuke-shi.

TEXT: [FI] Haha, a splendid Chuunibyou.

TEXT: [FI] W-Wha...?!

TEXT: [FI] C-C-C-C-Control yourself, Kirino----!

TEXT: [FI] Let me go! I'm going to kill her!

TEXT: [FI] Babbling nonsense just when I decide to listen for a while, who's a Chuunibyou?! Who's a kid?!

TEXT: [FI] ...Wait, hey. How did you know about Kuroneko's ambition to be a novelist?

TEXT: [FI] Which means...

TEXT: [FI] M-My... memories... have returned...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] S-S-S-S...

TEXT: [FI] Success-------!

TEXT: [FI] D-Don't hug my head! Ahhh, enough, let me go!

TEXT: [FI] Oh my? So you really did lose your memories? I really thought you had measles.

TEXT: [FI] L-Like I said, don't put me together with your Jakigan nonsense!

TEXT: [FI] Eh, Kyousuke-shi? Are you crying?

TEXT: [FI] S-Shut up!

TEXT: [FI] ...By any chance, were you both putting up an act just to anger Kirino...

TEXT: [FI] Eh, I really don't know what you're talking about...

TEXT: [FI] Huh? What's with this about the real me?

TEXT: [FI] My little sister is someone with a cheeky and extremely irritating personality, she calmly tells people to die, but...

TEXT: [FI] ...Even so, she's not a person that will hurt her friends.

TEXT: [FI] Kyousuke-shi...
